scope: Contexts describe syntax, not whether an import runs. TYPE_CHECKING labels recognize only literal spellings TYPE_CHECKING and typing.TYPE_CHECKING; aliases, rebinding, negation and truth values are not inferred. No imports are removed from the map. Function/class bodies, conditions, handlers, loops and other compound statement branches are retained outermost first. Dynamic calls and implicit package initialization are not resolved. Review collection skips, parse issues, collisions and source hashes.
collection_scope: Complete means collection finished within the stated budgets, not that runtime imports are known. Hidden and conventional dependency directories, symlinks and nonregular files are skipped. Explicit AST imports only; parse issues and dynamic calls remain visible. Use a stable source tree. These are input-size limits, not CPU, memory or elapsed-time guarantees.
